materials.name: Marble

materials.name: Granite
materials.copy: Dense natural stone suited to demanding interior and selected exterior applications, subject to stone-specific testing and finish review.

materials.name: Quartz
materials.copy: Engineered surface programs can support repeatable color directions and project schedules. Current slab specification and compliance documents must be confirmed.

materials.name: Engineered Marble

finishes.name: Leathered / Brushed
finishes.copy: Textured direction commonly considered for selected granite and natural stone. Availability depends on material and equipment review.

edges.name: Waterfall Return

applications.name: Restaurant Counter

faqs.q: What information should we send for a quotation?
faqs.a: Send drawings or dimensions, quantities, material direction, finish, edge, sink or cutout details, packing needs, destination, and required documents.

faqs.q: Can WHITEROCK work from CAD or PDF drawings?
faqs.a: Drawing-led review is available. File format, revision control, and shop-drawing scope are confirmed for each project.
Common North American cabinet formats can be discussed, while final dimensions and bowl positions follow the approved order drawing.
Yes. Feasibility, material yield, tolerances, reinforcement, and packing are reviewed before quotation.
Digital references are preliminary only. Use an approved physical sample and, for natural stone, review the relevant lot or slab selection.
Polished, honed, and selected textured directions may be available depending on the material and production review.

faqs.q: What edge profiles can be produced?
faqs.a: Eased, bevel, bullnose, decorative, mitered, and waterfall details can be evaluated from the drawing and approved sample.

faqs.q: Can sinks be supplied or mounted?
faqs.a: Sink sourcing, certification, cutout, mounting method, and included hardware must be confirmed for the specific program.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: MOQ depends on material, color, size, setup, packing, and whether the order is a sample, mixed program, or production run.

faqs.q: What is the production lead time?
faqs.a: Lead time is quoted after sample, drawing, commercial terms, material availability, and production scope are confirmed.
Foam, corner protection, cartons, pallets, crates, or A-frames are selected according to the product and shipment method.
Inspection arrangements can be discussed before order confirmation, including timing, checklist, access, and reporting format.
The document list is confirmed per order and destination. Buyers should verify current origin, customs, certification, and import requirements with qualified advisers.

faqs.q: Can we order samples before production?
faqs.a: Sample format, cost, courier charge, lead time, and what the sample represents are confirmed when the request is reviewed.

faqs.q: How do we start a distributor or project program?
faqs.a: Send your market, business type, expected product mix, annual volume direction, and current sourcing requirements through the trade inquiry form.
